description: This Java class named JavaSyntaxChecker provides functionality to validate Java code snippets for syntax errors. It reads code snippets from a JSON file, optionally wraps snippets in a Java class if needed, and uses JavaParser to parse and check each snippet, outputting validation results.

classes.name: JavaSyntaxChecker
classes.description: Main class that reads code snippets from a JSON file, parses each snippet to check for syntax errors, and outputs the results in JSON format.

classes.name: CodeSnippet
classes.description: Data model class representing a code snippet with its filePath, language, and code content.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the application; processes command-line arguments, reads code snippets, parses each snippet, and outputs syntax validation results.

methods.name: removeImports
methods.description: Removes import statements from a code snippet to facilitate wrapping into a class.

methods.name: cleanSnippet
methods.description: Prepares a code snippet for parsing by removing imports and wrapping it into a full class context if necessary.

methods.name: readCodeSnippets
methods.description: Reads a list of code snippets from a specified JSON file.
